privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_body: At Villzone Software Solutions Pvt Ltd , we prioritize the privacy and security of our clients, website visitors, and software application users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or utilize our digital products and enterprise solutions.
privacy.s1_intro: We may collect information about you in a variety of ways, including:
privacy.s1_1_desc: Name, email address, phone number, organization name, job title, and inquiry details provided voluntarily when submitting contact forms or requesting software product demos.
privacy.s1_2_desc: IP address, browser type, operating system, device characteristics, referring URLs, pages viewed, and access timestamps collected automatically via standard analytical technologies.
privacy.s1_3_desc: For users of our SaaS products (such as Matri-Connect, HRMS, and Doc Editor), data submitted within authenticated product environments is handled in accordance with specific enterprise customer agreements.
privacy.s2_item1: To provide, operate, and maintain our software applications and website.
privacy.s2_item2: To process product demo requests, inquiry responses, and customer support.
privacy.s2_item3: To improve user experience, platform performance, and security features.
privacy.s2_item4: To send administrative notifications, updates, and service-related communications.
privacy.s2_item5: To fulfill legal obligations and enforce our terms and service agreements.
privacy.s3_body: We employ industry-standard technical and organizational security measures—including TLS encryption, role-based access controls, and secure multi-tenant cloud storage—to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or misuse.
privacy.s3_disclaimer: However, please note that no internet transmission or electronic storage method can be guaranteed 100% secure. We encourage users to maintain secure passwords and protect their login credentials.
privacy.s4_body:
We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

Information may only be shared with trusted third-party service providers (such as hosting providers and communication APIs) who assist us in operating our software, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s5_body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data held by Villzone. You may also opt-out of marketing communications at any time by contacting us directly.
privacy.contact_desc: If you have any questions or concerns regarding our privacy policy or services, please contact us.
